# Security Blog

> Research, walkthroughs, and security notes focused on:

- [Security Blog](https://blog.annsh.online/index.md): Security Blog
- [Machine Walkthroughs](https://blog.annsh.online/walkthroughs/index.md): HackTheBox, TryHackMe, and CTF machine walkthroughs.
- [OSCP Preparation Guide](https://blog.annsh.online/oscp/index.md): OSCP preparation resources, enumeration techniques, privilege escalation notes, and cheatsheets.
- [Random](https://blog.annsh.online/random/index.md): Miscellaneous posts, lists, and things I find interesting.
- [Security Notes](https://blog.annsh.online/security-notes/index.md): Application security notes, OWASP Top 10 explanations, CVE analysis, and security concepts.
